issues.evidence: AOv13.tsx spots accents on 14 cuts, yet measure says cuts_on_sound_pct 40 and 15 cuts have no event (3.2, 11.2, 17.4, 19.6, 22.8, 36.8, 42.8, 45.8, 48.8, 51.3, 54.3, 67.3, 70.3, 73.3, 76.3). My RMS step at the cut (0.25 s after vs 0.4 s before): 11.2 = -6.7 dB, 36.8 = -5.1, 48.8 = -3.9, 54.3 = -2.0, 73.3 = +0.1. The soft whooshes (mixkit_1490/1486 at 0.25-0.3) are under the bed and have slow attacks.
issues.suggested_action: Replace the 1490/1486 swells with transient-first swishes or ticks (attack <20 ms), raise them to 0.5-0.6, pre-roll by 80-120 ms so the peak sits on the frame, and side-chain the music -3 dB for 150 ms on each cut.

issues.evidence: Cuts 17.4, 19.6 and 22.8 in the grind burst have no detected event; the step at 13.7 is +0.4 dB and at 14.4 +1.0 dB. The 'urgent' section is the least percussive. The screens (Excel edit, memo edit) have no keystroke bed: typing is only on the 0.5-0.7 s hand inserts (mixkit_1386 at 13.7 and 22.3).
issues.suggested_action: Run continuous close-miked typing under 14.4-16.9 and 17.4-19.6 (on-screen edits), add a mouse click at each cell or field change, and put a hard tick on every grind cut, 3-4 dB louder than the outside-grind accents.

issues.evidence: Accept click at 64.6 (mixkit_2568, the same file used at 0.25 on the Excel diff at 42.8) plus chime 2867 at 0.5. The step at 64.7 is only +2.1 dB, and VO 'It drives.
